title: The Rights of Children over Their Parents in Tarbiyah
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, citing Prophetic hadiths that highlight the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It mentions that among the child’s rights are that they be given a good name, taught, and disciplined. It also points out that parents are responsible for guiding their children toward goodness.
